details.title: NGSI-LD map
details.description: c³ Explore's map: the entities by their GeoProperties, coloured by type as in Explore, their Relationships as arrows, a moving one gliding - every source wired to it shown together; an entity clicked is sent on as the selection

preference.name: attribute
preference.label: Label
preference.description: The attribute whose value labels the entities - empty: their name, else their id

preference.name: relationships
preference.label: Relationships
preference.description: The Relationships drawn: every one, or only the selected entity's

preference.name: labelZoom
preference.label: Labels from zoom
preference.description: The zoom from which the entities have labels (as many as fit) - 0: always

inputendpoint.name: entities
inputendpoint.label: Entities
inputendpoint.description: {broker, tenant, type, entities}, from NGSI-LD sources - each source's entities kept, all of them drawn

inputendpoint.name: select
inputendpoint.label: Select
inputendpoint.description: {entities: [an entity]} - that entity selected and centred (a table's or a graph's selection)
